verdict.rationale: The documented Intelligent Commerce REST endpoints carry an explicit version segment (POST /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens, /acp/v1/instructions/{instructionID}/credentials), so API versioning is evident. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, and the product page warns it is "in the process of development and deployment," which weakens any stability guarantee. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a versioning or compatibility policy statement, a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration of version stability.
